labels.name: rag_search
labels.description: Semantic search across the authenticated user's vectorized documents and knowledge base. Returns the most relevant text chunks with similarity scores.

labels.name: memory_search
labels.description: Search the authenticated user's stored long-term memories (preferences, facts, context) using semantic similarity.

labels.name: memory_add
labels.description: Store a new long-term memory for the authenticated user — a durable fact or preference that Synaplan will recall in future conversations.

labels.name: file_ingest
labels.description: Add a text document to the authenticated user's knowledge base. The content is chunked, embedded, and stored so it becomes retrievable via rag_search.

labels.name: rag_similar
labels.description: Find document chunks similar to a given source message/document id (the `message_id` returned by rag_search).

labels.name: list_chats
labels.description: List the authenticated user's conversations (most recently updated first).

labels.name: get_messages
labels.description: Return the messages of one of the user's chats, in chronological order.

labels.name: list_prompts
labels.description: List the user's available Synaplan task prompts (internal `tools:*` prompts excluded).

labels.name: list_assistants
labels.description: List assistants the authenticated user may use from a connected app. Each row includes slug, name, description, version and origin.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: synaplan_chat, list_chats, get_messages · Private data: synaplan_chat, rag_search, file_ingest, rag_similar · Public sink: synaplan_chat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: synaplan_chat, list_chats, get_messages · Private data: synaplan_chat, rag_search, file_ingest, rag_similar · Public sink: synaplan_chat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
